---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**
What are you trying to do that Reeler doesn't support today?

**Proposed solution**
What would you like to happen? If it touches the AI pipeline, note which
capability (STT / LLM / image-gen / rendering) and whether it needs a new
provider — see docs/ai_pipeline.md.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.

**Additional context**
Mockups, links, related issues, etc.
